card.title: Sell the Disaster
card.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

mechanism: A makes an already risky auction advance seem responsible by using each failure to justify greater financial commitment.
confusable: Unlike simple denial of loss, A must argue that preserving the bad plan is now the responsible necessity.
comparison: D17-b treats self-bidding on raised credit as protecting charity; D17-a treats loss of trading days as investment in umbrellas.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
